conviction_note: The quarter's originations are already public ($4.12bn, -2.6% q/q, pre-released 2026-10-05), so the print turns on take rate, contribution margin and the FY2026 guide. Consensus Q3+Q4 revenue (~$750m) sits about $20m above the ~$727m H2 that the reaffirmed ~$1.4bn FY guide implies, and the Fed hiked on 2026-09-16, after that guide was set. Against that: short interest is ~26% of float with 7.3 days to cover, the stock is at its 52-week low, and puts carry a 16.8-vol skew, so a reaffirm can squeeze. 6 of the last 7 prints fell. The result is a slight negative lean (p_up 45) on a large unsigned move (13%), and the -1.2 sum of findings agrees with that in sign and size.
bar: Company: FY2026 total revenue ~$1.4bn, fee revenue ~$1.3bn, adj. EBITDA ~$294m (21% margin), reaffirmed 2026-08-04 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1647639/000164763926000062/upst991prq22026.htm); no quarterly guidance. Street Q3 revenue ~$365.1-365.5m, Q3 adj. EBITDA ~$83.2m, Q4 revenue ~$383-386m (TIKR 2026-10-11, https://www.tikr.com/blog/upstart-stock-sits-about-7-above-its-52-week-low-as-q3-originations-top-4-1-billion-time-to-sell-or-load-up ; a second search-snippet source gives $365.5m / $385.8m). The two estimate sources roughly agree. H1 revenue was $672.7m ($308m Q1 + $364.7m Q2), so the guide implies an H2 of ~$727m.
positioning_check: Short interest 25.92% of float, 7.3 days to cover, as of the 2026-08-19 settlement (equibles.com/stocks/UPST). Tapeboard showed 31.0-32.6% of float in July 2026. I found no October reading. Baseline: 25-delta skew +16.76 vol points (downside paid), put/call OI 0.73, ATM IV 145%, event-implied move 12.62%. Spot $21.69 is at the 52-week low, -57% from the high, -10.9% over 20 days and -5.7% over 5 days. A crowded short sits against a put-bid tape, and 6 of the last 7 reactions were down.

findings.finding: Q3 2026 originations were pre-released on 2026-10-05 at $4,117.8m: -2.6% q/q against Q2's $4,227.2m, and $51.6m per origination day against $53.9m in Q2. Q2 fee revenue was $348.0m on $4,227m of originations, an 8.23% take. At that take, Q3 fees come to ~$339m, and with Q2's ~$16.7m of other revenue that gives ~$356m total revenue, against a ~$365m consensus that is flat q/q. Matching consensus requires the take rate to rise ~20bp again (management said on the Q2 call it expects take rates to be relatively stable).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026: revenue $364.7m against ~$352m consensus, a ~3.6% beat, with the guide reaffirmed: -0.4%. Q1 2026: revenue beat but adj. EBITDA missed ($40.5m): -7.9%. The name has not paid for revenue beats.
findings.why_not_priced: The originations number itself is priced; it is public. What may not be priced is the arithmetic: a consensus flat q/q on revenue while volume fell 2.6% embeds a take-rate rise. If the market had priced a ~2.5% revenue miss, consensus would have been trimmed toward ~$355m after the 10-05 release. The figures I found still read ~$365m.
findings.independence: The Q2 fee and origination figures come from the Q2 press release (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1647639/000164763926000062/upst991prq22026.htm), a different document from the TIKR pre-release summary. The September monthly release (https://investingnews.com/upstart-publishes-september-2026-originations-and-latest-umi) confirms the $4,117.8m quarter.

findings.finding: The FY2026 guide (~$1.4bn revenue, ~$1.3bn fees, ~$294m adj. EBITDA) less H1 actuals ($672.7m revenue, $625m fees, $117.4m EBITDA) implies H2 revenue of ~$727m (~$363m a quarter) and H2 fees of ~$675m (~$337m a quarter, below Q2's $348m). Street Q3 $365m plus Q4 $383-386m is ~$750m, ~$20-25m above the guide-implied H2. A reaffirm at ~$1.4bn therefore implies a Q4 of ~$365-370m, below the Q4 consensus. The guide was set when UMI was ~1.50, before the Fed's 2026-09-16 hike.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026: FY guide reaffirmed (not raised) on a beat: -0.4%. 2026-02-10, first annual guide: -15.0%. A raised guide has not been tested in this 2026 annual-guide regime.
findings.why_not_priced: Q4 consensus sits above what the company's own guide implies. If the market had priced a guide-implied Q4, consensus would sit near ~$367m, not $383-386m. The street appears to treat the ~$1.4bn as a floor that will be raised, so a plain reaffirm reads as an implied Q4 cut.
findings.independence: Q1 revenue comes from the Q1 release (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001647639/000164763926000045/upst991prq12026.htm) and the Q4 consensus from TIKR (https://www.tikr.com/blog/upstart-stock-sits-about-7-above-its-52-week-low-as-q3-originations-top-4-1-billion-time-to-sell-or-load-up). Partly shares the take-rate concern of finding 1 but lands on a different line, the guide. Counterweight: 'approximately' $1.4bn leaves room, and the EBITDA bar is in line (H2 implied $176.6m against $177m consensus).

findings.finding: Upstart publishes prior-month originations on the third calendar day after month end, or pre-market on the next business day. October 2026 volume is therefore due on Tuesday 2026-11-03, almost certainly with the results: the first hard read on Q4 against a consensus that needs Q4 revenue up ~5% q/q. Q3 per-day run rates were July $51.0m, August $50.7m and September $53.1m, against May $58.2m and June $55.5m.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No separate history: the monthly releases began in 2026 and this is the first one bundled with a print.
findings.why_not_priced: The number does not exist yet. The sign is unknown; September's run rate ($53.1m a day) rose from August's, which slightly favours a stable October.
findings.independence: The August release (https://secure.businesswire.com/news/home/20260903664737/en/Upstart-Publishes-August-2026-Originations-and-Latest-UMI) and the September release (https://investingnews.com/upstart-publishes-september-2026-originations-and-latest-umi) confirm the cadence and the monthly figures.

findings.finding: The Fed raised rates 25bp to 3.75-4.00% on 2026-09-16, its first hike since 2023, and held on 2026-10-28 with a December hike priced. All of this came after Upstart set its FY guide assumptions on 2026-08-04. Higher rates raise loan APRs and lower approvals for a marketplace lender, and capital-markets funding costs rise. Against that, Upstart's own Macro Index read 1.49 on 2026-10-05, against the ~1.50 the guide assumes.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2025-08 and 2026-05 prints sold off on funding and margin worries (-18.7%, -7.9%); macro tightening has historically compressed UPST conversion.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: the stock fell from ~$24 to $21.69 after the hike. What is not yet visible is how management translates it into the 2027 commentary or into Q4 volume, which the call will reveal.
findings.independence: Proxy: macro-to-company transmission. The company's UMI (https://investingnews.com/upstart-publishes-september-2026-originations-and-latest-umi) was flat at 1.49, which cuts against it. October FOMC hold: https://investinglive.com/central-banks/fomc-decision-oct-28/

findings.finding: Closest peer Happen (ex-LendingClub) reported Q3 2026 on 2026-10-28: originations ~$3.3bn, up ~24% y/y and at the top of its $3.2-3.35bn guide; diluted EPS $0.50, +35% y/y; FY originations narrowed to $12.3-12.4bn and EPS raised to $1.87-1.92. Revenue missed consensus at $263.2m. Consumer-loan investor demand held up after the Fed hike.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No measured peer read-through for UPST in the baseline.
findings.why_not_priced: It landed after Upstart last spoke (the 10-05 volume release). UPST still fell ~5.7% over the five days through 11-02, so the market did not take the peer as a positive read-through for UPST funding.
findings.independence: Happen 3Q26 presentation (https://s25.q4cdn.com/479304653/files/content_files/Happen_-Inc-3Q26-Earnings-Presentation.pdf); the revenue miss is in https://stockstory.org/us/stocks/nasdaq/hapn/news/earnings/happen-bank-nasdaqhapn-misses-q3-2026-revenue-estimates

findings.finding: 8-K filed 2026-10-20: a $200m senior secured 364-day revolver with MUFG (SOFR+300bp), for 'initial capitalization of Upstart Bank' and general corporate purposes. It is repaid from loan sales to Upstart Bank once the bank opens, with covenants of minimum $100m liquidity and secured leverage of 2.5x or less. The bank holds conditional OCC approval; FDIC and Fed approvals are pending.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: August 2025 $500m convertible: -7.7% on the day (not an earnings reaction). The CEO called the bank 'a cost center with no benefit in 2026'.
findings.why_not_priced: It is public, but the call will be the first time management explains the bank timeline and its expense load into 2027. The money buys the capitalization of a bank that would give Upstart deposit funding, a long-run funding positive and a near-term cost. It is not distress funding.
findings.independence: TIKR (2026-10-11) on the bank's regulatory status and the CEO's 'cost center' remark: https://www.tikr.com/blog/upstart-stock-sits-about-7-above-its-52-week-low-as-q3-originations-top-4-1-billion-time-to-sell-or-load-up

findings.finding: Insider activity: CEO Paul Gu bought 50,000 shares on 2026-09-10 at a $25.55 weighted average (Form 4); President Sanjay Datta sold ~116,000 shares (~$3.2m) in August-September 2026.
findings.why_not_priced: Public Form 4s. The CEO buy above today's price is weak evidence that he saw no Q3 problem as of 09-10, more than two-thirds of the way through the quarter.
findings.independence: Same TIKR document as findings 1 and 6; not verified on EDGAR Form 4 in this hunt.

findings.finding: The Q2 2026 10-Q/A states that, as of 2026-06-30, certain personal-loan vintages from Q4 2024 (excluding small-dollar loans) are forecast to underperform their target returns. That is a standing credit-quality flag that matters for funding partners after the Fed hike.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Credit and funding worries drove the -18.7% reaction (2025-08) and the -15.0% reaction (2026-02).
findings.why_not_priced: It was disclosed in August, so it is mostly priced. The Q3 10-Q will update which vintages underperform, and widening that list would be new.

findings.finding: Positioning: short interest ~26% of float with 7.3 days to cover (2026-08-19 settlement), the stock at its 52-week low ($21.69, -57% from the high, -10.9% over 20 days), and a put skew of +16.8 vol points. A reaffirmed guide plus a stable October volume print gives a squeeze mechanism inside the session, because the 07:00 ET release leaves a full session to cover.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2025-02-11: +31.8%, the one up reaction in the last seven, came with a heavy short. The other six were down 0.4-18.7%.
findings.why_not_priced: Crowded downside positioning (puts bid, shorts high, stock at its low) means much of the negative case is in the price. A squeeze is a mechanism of its own, not a view.
findings.independence: Tapeboard 31-32.6% of float, July 2026 (https://tapeboard.com/stock/UPST/short-squeeze); skew from the sealed baseline.

findings.finding: First pre-market release in the name's history: results at ~07:00 ET and webcast at 08:00 ET on 2026-11-03, announced 2026-10-06. Every prior print in the baseline was amc. The whole reaction, including the call, now falls inside one regular session.
findings.why_not_priced: It carries no direction and bears only on scale; the change came with no stated reason.

outside_window.finding: Upstart Bank opening, which needs FDIC deposit insurance and Fed approval, treated as a 2027 question; loan sales to the bank repay the MUFG revolver.
December 2026 FOMC (2026-12-09), with a further hike priced.

baseline_tension: The findings lean slightly negative, in line with the put skew and the 6-of-7-down reaction history, but the crowded short and the 52-week-low price cut against adding to the negative, so p_up stays near 50 (45).
lessons_applied: Lesson 7 (crowded short ~26% of float, 7.3 days to cover): negatives shrunk once: reported-quarter take-rate -1.0 to -0.8, guide-implied Q4 -1.5 to -1.2, Fed macro proxy -0.7 to -0.5
Lesson 4 (financing is a question): the MUFG revolver funds bank capitalization and is repaid by loan sales to the bank, not distress, so -0.3 to -0.1
Lesson 1 (this name sells beats): p_up and abs_move left as drafted (45, 13); already reflected
Lesson 6 (bar): consensus from two roughly agreeing sources plus the company FY guide, so no cap applied
